|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/concussiongrenade.html</ref>

The [[Concussion Grenade]] isn't the most exact of weapons, but it can be a great way to clear out a site in a hurry. Especially in a trooper deck, a [[Concussion Grenade]] can be a terrific way to even the score in a battle, or clear out a neighboring site so that you can move in and Force drain. With [[Sorry About The Mess]], you can toss the Grenade during your [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] phase, making its effects far more useful. Also, with [[Under Attack]], the [[Concussion Grenade]] can be used to good effect by taking out a pesky Walker, especially against a [[Walker Garrison]] deck.

Combos:

[[Concussion Grenade]] + [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo){{!}}R2-D2]] + [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace){{!}}Artoo]] -- With the variety of destinies that you can get from the two versions of R2, you can choose the variety that suits your taste. Granted, though, that few characters have a destiny of 5 or 6, but in the rare case that this helps, it can be used to devastating effect, especially against insert decks.
|combos=* [[Concussion Grenade]] + [[Under Attack]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Concussion%20Grenade</ref>
